subject: Confirmation of Hotel Reservation
body: Dear Mr. Smith, We are pleased to confirm your reservation at the Grand Hotel for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your booking details are as follows: Check-in date: 15th August 2023 Check-out date: 20th August 2023 Room type: Deluxe Double Room If you have any special requests or need to make changes to your reservation, please feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you to our hotel! Best regards, The Grand Hotel Team
